checkedAlternates.risk: Columns stand on the cave floor.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A column forms only when a ceiling stalactite and floor stalagmite merge together (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Stalactite and stalagmite are frequently swapped.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Stalactites hang from the ceiling (group-3), while stalagmites grow upward from the floor (group-2).
